name: arrow-left
description: A solid rounded triangular arrowhead with a straight shaft.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Straight centerlines keep the symbol readable without an enclosing frame. Centerline bounds x=4..20 and y=6..18 give balanced opposite visible margins of 3.15 horizontally and 5.15 vertically. The arrow pair is mirrored about x=12. Filled line contours are constructed as the union of radius-.85 segment capsules, matching the native Regular 1.70 stroke exterior, free-end caps and round joins. For closed objects, the body remains solid with explicitly authored negative-space details. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Owner rejected the radius-1.50 curved-head experiment on2026-10-27. Return to the original straight-arm V head with round .85 caps and round stroke joins at Regular1.70. Do not reintroduce a broad centerline fillet. Owner requested a solid arrowhead for every Filled arrow on2026-10-27. Outline retains the open straight-arm V. Filled closes that same head into a solid triangular body, including the Regular1.70 round exterior at its three corners; shaft and tray geometry are retained. Corresponding tip, arm endpoints, native outer bounds and Regular1.70 weight remain aligned. This is a semantic solid-head exception to reproducing the open Outline interior. Owner approved this current pair on2026-10-27.

review.note: Owner approved both current styles: open straight-arm V head in Outline and solid triangular head in Filled, with aligned tips/endpoints, original shafts/trays and Regular1.70 reference.
